The '''''Conraddas Vindicator''''' was a [[Color/Legends|white]]-hulled [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] with orange markings that served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The ''Vindicator'' was one of the Republic vessels assigned to accompany a [[Prototype warship fleet|fleet]] of prototype [[Warship/Legends|warships]] that was preparing for an assault on the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in [[3665 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> However, the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was attacked by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] while passing along a [[Secret route through the Hoth system|secret route]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The carrier took part in the resultant [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]], which lasted several [[Standard day/Legends|days]] and crossed several [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] before reaching its peak in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]],<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> but at the end of the engagement the ''Vindicator'' was among the more than seventy-five vessels that crashed on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Its wreckage was scattered over several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] on the surface of Hoth.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Conraddis Vindicator'' was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', in the guide's section on the planet Hoth. The ship in question originated in concept art for Hoth, which first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''.
